titulo: The Broken Mirror: the First Shard
descripcion: A shard of the Shattered Mirror that Drusa Malter was looking for has reached the tholos. Find it and take it to Senet.

pasos.texto: Look for the shard beside the olive tree, to the south-west of the hall
Take the shard to Senet, next to the tower

textos.aceptada: Beside the olive tree, to the south-west. Don't stare at it for long.
textos.completada: A Conflict Piece in your bag: the broken mirror already knows you.

notas: Template of the tabletop room: the door into «The Broken Mirror», an adventure for the tabletop manual. The real game is run by a person at the table.
